prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ makeDirectory }`. `makeDirectory(entries)` accepts an array of records shaped as `{ code, title }`, where both fields are non-empty strings and every `code` is unique. Invalid input, malformed records, or duplicate codes must throw `TypeError`. The function must copy the input and return an object with two methods: `get(code)`, which returns a fresh copy of the matching record or `null`; and `search(term, limit)`, which performs a case-insensitive substring search on `title` and returns fresh copies in original input order. `term` must be a string. `limit` must be a non-negative integer and defaults to the directory size. An empty term matches every entry, and a limit of zero returns an empty array. Later mutations to inputs or returned records must not affect the directory. Implement the module as one complete source file without external packages.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
